profile: Assembly Biosciences develops investigational therapies for serious viral diseases. Its clinical and research programs include long-acting helicase-primase inhibitors for recurrent genital herpes, an oral hepatitis delta virus entry inhibitor, a next-generation hepatitis B virus capsid assembly modulator, and an oral polymerase inhibitor for transplant-associated herpesviruses. The company also conducts research into additional antiviral targets and collaborates with Gilead on its herpes program.
